labels.label: bcor:abel

hypotheses.paper: §8 setting: S complete Riemannian, Gamma = pi_1(S) acting on S~ (l.2212-2275)
hypotheses.note: DEC-35 reading CCAction Gamma S, as in Flat/Develop and Flat/Loxodromic

hypotheses.paper: Gamma preserves a spacelike affine subspace U (l.2295)
hypotheses.note: IsSpacelikeAffine U (every nonzero direction vector spacelike; a point qualifies), U nonempty, Gamma-invariant

bcor_abel asks Delta = R v Gamma-invariant (L(gamma) v in R v); necessary, since without it the statement is false (not_bcorAbelPrinted). Orthogonality Delta perp U is not used (weakened). bcor_abel_twoNull replaces it by two Gamma-invariant null directions (the [10.M] shape)
external BieberbachI (DEC-36, Flat/Bieberbach) in dimension dim U (bcor_abel) or 1 + dim U (bcor_abel_twoNull); a Prop hypothesis, not an axiom

findings: Cor 8.4 (l.2295-2296) is FALSE as printed, now formalized (not_bcorAbelPrinted, no sorry, axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound) in every dimension d >= 2 (Barbot's n >= 3). Witness bcor_abel_counterexample: Gamma4 = image of the level-4 congruence subgroup Gamma(4) of SL(2,Z) acting on (t,x0,x1) by X = [[t+x0,x1],[x1,t-x0]] -> M X M^T and trivially on the other coordinates; Sigma = the hyperboloid. Hypotheses satisfied: CCAction Gamma4 Sigma (Sigma satisfies (CC'), is Gamma4-invariant, the action is free (a fixed point in H^2 forces |tr M| < 2 while tr M = 2 mod 4) and properly discontinuous (integer entries bounded on compacta)), i.e. Gamma4 is the holonomy of the Cauchy-complete GH flat spacetime Gamma4 \ {t > |x|} in the DEC-35 reading; Gamma4 fixes POINTWISE the spacelike U = {t = x0 = x1 = 0} (a point for d = 2, a line for d = 3, containing e_i for i >= 2). Conclusion fails: no finite-index subgroup of Gamma4 is commutative (u^k l^m != l^m u^k for the two unipotent generators), so Gamma4 is not virtually Z^k. The spacetime is Cauchy-complete, not Cauchy-compact (Gamma(4) is not cocompact); the earlier Fuchsian x Z example (cocompact) is not formalized.

The failing step is l.2300-2301 'the action of Gamma on pi(U) has to be free and properly discontinuous, and the same is true for the action on U': its freeness half on U is refuted as a Prop (not_bcorAbelStepPrinted: Gamma4 fixes U pointwise). pi is Gamma-equivariant only if Delta is Gamma-invariant, and no nontrivial element of Gamma4 preserves any timelike direction (gamma4_not_fix_timelike).

Strongest true form (bcor_abel): add 'Delta = R v is Gamma-invariant' (equivalently L(Gamma) fixes the future timelike v, linOf_eq_self_of_smul). Then Gamma acts freely and properly discontinuously on ALL of M^n (abel_free_of_fix, abel_proper_of_fix, unconditional: the line x + R v meets Sigma at s with gamma s - s = gamma x - x), the restriction Gamma -> Isom(U) (read in an orthonormal frame of U, exists_spacelike_frame, Mazur-Ulam) is injective with discrete image, and BieberbachI gives a finite-index subgroup ~ Z^m, m <= dim U. Delta perp U is not needed.

[10.M] l.3326 ('As in corollary abel, we see that the action on pi_P^{-1}(0) is free and properly discontinuous'): false as printed too, since there L(Gamma) preserves two null directions and a pure boost fixes P pointwise (Misner; not formalized). The true replacement is bcor_abel_twoNull: if Gamma preserves a spacelike U and two distinct null directions R l0, R l1 (eigenvalues lambda^{-1}, lambda), gamma -> (log lambda(gamma), gamma|_U) embeds Gamma discretely in Isom(R x U), so Gamma is virtually Z^m, m <= dim U + 1 (conditional on BieberbachI(R x R^{dim U})). Neither l_i perp U nor dim U = d - 1 is used. It yields 'virtually abelian' for [10.M], not yet the 'linear twisted product over a Misner spacetime' conclusion.

Prop 10.4 (l.3355-3356, spacelike case) cannot be served by either corrected form: there L(Gamma) is non-elementary, and in that regime Cor 8.4's conclusion fails (the Gamma4 example is non-elementary); Flat/Loxodromic's route around Cor 8.4 stands.
questions: Is a point (0-dimensional U) a 'spacelike affine subspace' in Barbot's sense? The formalization admits it (IsSpacelikeAffine is vacuous on direction {0}); the counterexample does not depend on this for d >= 3, where U is at least a line.

Which corrected statement should the ledger row carry as principal (kb/0022): bcor_abel (Delta-invariant, the repair of the printed proof) or bcor_abel_twoNull (the shape [10.M] uses)? Both are in the file; the author may want a single statement covering 'L(Gamma)|_{U^perp} fixes a timelike vector or two null directions'.

kb_proposals: A non-elementary discrete group acting freely and properly on the hyperboloid is cheap through SL(2,Z): Flat/Abel's sl2Lin (X -> M X M^T on (t,x0,x1)) with the level-4 congruence group gamma4; freeness is pure algebra (tr M = 2 mod 4 vs |tr M| < 2), properness is bounded integer entries. Reuse ccAction_gamma4 for any counterexample needing a non-virtually-abelian CCAction.
Flat/Examples defines Causal.Flat.frameConj (conjugating a group by an isometry); importing Examples clashes with any new 'frameConj'. Grep the imported modules, not only the target directory.

In a long proof over WithLp 2 (R x E) and a set-bound monoid hom, 'set' and 'rw ... at' on dist hypotheses hit isDefEq timeouts; isolate WithLp arithmetic in small standalone lemmas (abel_dist_L2_bound, twoNull_disp_bound).
notes: Single file, no sorry, no axiom; #print axioms of not_bcorAbelPrinted, bcor_abel, bcor_abel_twoNull, abel_free_of_fix, abel_proper_of_fix = propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Build: taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean scaffold/CausalScaffold/Flat/Abel.lean, zero errors, zero warnings (~25 s). Imports: Flat.Develop, Flat.Bieberbach, Flat.Examples, Mathlib MazurUlam; none of the concurrently edited modules. 112 public names checked free across Causal/, scaffold/ and lean-gx (the first draft's frameConj collided with Flat/Examples and was renamed uFrameConj). bcor_abel and bcor_abel_twoNull are conditional on the external BieberbachI (DEC-36), carried as an explicit hypothesis. The label stays unmarked (printed statement false; corrected forms add a hypothesis). curation.toml's bcor:abel row ('No Lean ... not formalized') is now out of date: the counterexample is formalized here. The module is not yet in the scaffold root import list (kb/0025: the axiom sweep cannot see it until the master adds it).
